+# The ONNX Runtime used by laya_onnx: LAYA_ONNXRUNTIME_ROOT (an unpacked release) or the pinned
+# release archive, verified by sha256 at the moment of download. Defines the imported target laya_ort.
+set(LAYA_ORT_VERSION "1.30.0")
+include(FetchContent)
+
+if(LAYA_ONNXRUNTIME_ROOT)
+  set(_ort_root "${LAYA_ONNXRUNTIME_ROOT}")
+else()
+  set(_ort_base "https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/releases/download/v${LAYA_ORT_VERSION}")
+  string(TOLOWER "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}-${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}" _ort_platform)
+  if(_ort_platform STREQUAL "linux-x86_64")
+    set(_ort_asset "onnxruntime-linux-x64-${LAYA_ORT_VERSION}.tgz")
+    set(_ort_sha256 "a5ed5a3cac51fbb2e90da632ae43d19212faaa20e76484e62bcb7c23ddb3b3fd")
+  elseif(_ort_platform STREQUAL "darwin-arm64")
+    set(_ort_asset "onnxruntime-osx-arm64-${LAYA_ORT_VERSION}.tgz")
+    set(_ort_sha256 "6ebb5062a934537c352937821f9fe9718e7de1a2db1122a93dd363ffd53a7012")
+  else()
+    message(FATAL_ERROR "No pinned ONNX Runtime for ${_ort_platform}; unpack a ${LAYA_ORT_VERSION} release and pass -DLAYA_ONNXRUNTIME_ROOT=<dir>")
+  endif()
+  # URL_HASH makes CMake verify the archive before it is extracted; a mismatch is a configure error.
+  FetchContent_Declare(onnxruntime
+    URL "${_ort_base}/${_ort_asset}"
+    URL_HASH SHA256=${_ort_sha256}
+    DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP TRUE)
+  FetchContent_MakeAvailable(onnxruntime)
+  set(_ort_root "${onnxruntime_SOURCE_DIR}")
+endif()
+
+if(NOT EXISTS "${_ort_root}/include/onnxruntime_cxx_api.h")
+  message(FATAL_ERROR "${_ort_root}/include/onnxruntime_cxx_api.h not found: not an ONNX Runtime release directory")
+endif()
+# The pinned release is what the tests and goldens were measured against, so an override must be it.
+string(REGEX MATCH "^[0-9]+\\.([0-9]+)\\." _ort_unused "${LAYA_ORT_VERSION}")
+set(_ort_want_api "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
+file(STRINGS "${_ort_root}/include/onnxruntime_c_api.h" _ort_api_line REGEX "^#define ORT_API_VERSION [0-9]+")
+string(REGEX REPLACE "^#define ORT_API_VERSION ([0-9]+).*" "\\1" _ort_api "${_ort_api_line}")
+if(NOT _ort_api STREQUAL _ort_want_api)
+  message(FATAL_ERROR "${_ort_root} is ONNX Runtime API version '${_ort_api}', but laya_onnx is pinned to ${LAYA_ORT_VERSION} (API version ${_ort_want_api})")
+endif()
+if(EXISTS "${_ort_root}/VERSION_NUMBER")
+  file(STRINGS "${_ort_root}/VERSION_NUMBER" _ort_vn LIMIT_COUNT 1)
+  if(NOT _ort_vn STREQUAL LAYA_ORT_VERSION)
+    message(FATAL_ERROR "${_ort_root}/VERSION_NUMBER says '${_ort_vn}', but laya_onnx is pinned to ${LAYA_ORT_VERSION}")
+  endif()
+endif()
+if(APPLE)
+  set(_ort_lib "${_ort_root}/lib/libonnxruntime.${LAYA_ORT_VERSION}.dylib")
+  if(NOT EXISTS "${_ort_lib}")
+    file(GLOB _ort_lib "${_ort_root}/lib/libonnxruntime*.dylib")
+    if(NOT _ort_lib)
+      message(FATAL_ERROR "no libonnxruntime*.dylib under ${_ort_root}/lib")
+    endif()
+    list(GET _ort_lib 0 _ort_lib)
+  endif()
+elseif(WIN32)
+  set(_ort_lib "${_ort_root}/lib/onnxruntime.lib")
+else()
+  set(_ort_lib "${_ort_root}/lib/libonnxruntime.so")
+endif()
+if(NOT EXISTS "${_ort_lib}")
+  message(FATAL_ERROR "ONNX Runtime library not found: ${_ort_lib}")
+endif()
+message(STATUS "ONNX Runtime ${LAYA_ORT_VERSION}: ${_ort_lib}")
+
+add_library(laya_ort SHARED IMPORTED)
+set_target_properties(laya_ort PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${_ort_lib}" INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${_ort_root}/include")
+set(LAYA_ORT_LIBDIR "${_ort_root}/lib")
+set(LAYA_ORT_ROOT "${_ort_root}")
+
+# Build-tree executables find the shared library through an rpath to its directory.
+function(laya_ort_runtime_path target)
+  set_property(TARGET ${target} APPEND PROPERTY BUILD_RPATH "${LAYA_ORT_LIBDIR}")
+endfunction()

+#pragma once
+// Pads built sequences into the rectangular tensors the graph takes (laya-go/internal/collate).
+// One row per question, not per state: four questions about one document are four rows that share
+// a state. Rows are padded to the longest sequence and markers to the most options.
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <vector>
+
+#include "laya/infer.hpp"
+#include "laya/result.hpp"
+#include "laya/schema.hpp"
+
+namespace laya {
+namespace collate {
+
+// The fewest option slots the graph accepts: one-option rows get a masked second slot that
+// decoding never reads.
+constexpr int64_t kMinMarkerSlots = 2;
+
+struct Row {
+  std::vector<int32_t> ids;
+  std::vector<int64_t> markers;
+  schema::Type type = schema::Type::Invalid;
+};
+
+// pad_id is fed to the encoder under a zero mask, so it must be a real vocabulary id. Refuses an
+// empty list, a row with no ids, a row with an invalid type, a marker outside its ids, a negative
+// id, and a batch that would exceed infer::kMaxTensorElements.
+Result<infer::Batch> Collate(const std::vector<Row>& rows, int32_t pad_id);
+
+// How many states each session run takes when one run must not exceed infer::kMaxTensorElements in
+// any tensor. Each state contributes rows_per_state rows of length[i] tokens and width[i] markers,
+// taken in order; a state that alone exceeds the cap still gets a run (Collate refuses it).
+std::vector<size_t> PlanRuns(size_t rows_per_state, const std::vector<int64_t>& length, const std::vector<int64_t>& width);
+
+}  // namespace collate
+}  // namespace laya

+#pragma once
+// The ONNX Runtime backend (laya-go/onnx). Linking laya_onnx pulls in ONNX Runtime; the core `laya`
+// library never does, and this header includes no ONNX Runtime header.
+#include <cstdint>
+#include <memory>
+#include <string>
+#include "laya/agent.hpp"
+#include "laya/infer.hpp"
+#include "laya/result.hpp"
+
+namespace laya {
+namespace onnx {
+
+struct Options {
+  // 0 leaves ONNX Runtime's default (one intra-op pool sized to the cores). Every session owns its
+  // own pool and sessions do not share one, so many sessions in one process should set this. There
+  // is no inter-op option: the graph runs sequentially, where it would have no effect.
+  int intra_op_threads = 0;  // at most kMaxThreads
+};
+constexpr int kMaxThreads = 4096;
+
+// The version of the ONNX Runtime library loaded, e.g. "1.30.0".
+std::string RuntimeVersion();
+
+// A Session over one fused laya.onnx (+ laya.onnx.data beside it). Checks the graph's inputs and
+// outputs at once. Run is thread-safe and stops in flight when its CancelToken fires (kCancelled).
+// Close is idempotent, refuses new runs, terminates the runs in flight and returns once they have
+// left. A Session or Agent may be held in a static, closed or not. No exception leaves this API.
+// The first Open sets ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 unless it is already set: the runtime's telemetry
+// thread can abort the process at exit. A program that builds its own OrtEnv first must set it too.
+Result<std::unique_ptr<infer::Session>> Open(const std::string& graph_path, const Options& options = {});
+
+}  // namespace onnx
+
+namespace agent {
+// checkpoint_dir holds rl_agent_config.json and the tokenizer; graph_path is the fused laya.onnx.
+Result<std::unique_ptr<Agent>> OpenOnnx(const std::string& checkpoint_dir, const std::string& graph_path,
+                                        const onnx::Options& options = {});
+}  // namespace agent
+
+}  // namespace laya

+#!/bin/sh
+# Configure-only check of cmake/onnxruntime.cmake's refusals. usage: check_ort_root.sh <good-ort-root>
+# A root with the wrong API version, a wrong VERSION_NUMBER, no header, or no library must each
+# fail at configure time with the named message, and the good root must configure.
+set -eu
+good=$1
+src=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+tmp=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
+fail=0
+try() {  # name root want-substring ("" = must succeed)
+  if out=$(cmake -S "$src" -B "$tmp/b-$1" -DLAYA_ONNX=ON -DLAYA_ONNXRUNTIME_ROOT="$2" 2>&1); then rc=0; else rc=1; fi
+  if [ -z "$3" ]; then
+    [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL $1: good root refused"; fail=1; }
+  else
+    [ $rc -ne 0 ] || { echo "FAIL $1: accepted"; fail=1; return; }
+    echo "$out" | tr -s ' \n' '  ' | grep -q "$3" || { echo "FAIL $1: wrong message"; echo "$out" | tail -4; fail=1; }
+  fi
+}
+copy() { mkdir -p "$tmp/$1"; cp -R "$good/include" "$tmp/$1/include"; mkdir -p "$tmp/$1/lib"; cp -R "$good/lib/." "$tmp/$1/lib/"; cp "$good/VERSION_NUMBER" "$tmp/$1/" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+try good "$good" ""
+copy api; sed -i.bak 's/^#define ORT_API_VERSION [0-9]*/#define ORT_API_VERSION 99/' "$tmp/api/include/onnxruntime_c_api.h"
+try wrong-api "$tmp/api" "API version '99'"
+copy vn; echo 1.29.0 > "$tmp/vn/VERSION_NUMBER"
+try wrong-version-number "$tmp/vn" "VERSION_NUMBER says"
+copy nohdr; rm "$tmp/nohdr/include/onnxruntime_cxx_api.h"
